Method of Attack: Uploading malicious packages to PyPI camouflaged as legitimate modules
Executing malicious function from __init__.py that triggers data collection
Sending collected data to attacker’s command and control (C2) servers via POST HTTP request
Downloading obfuscated Python module from C2 server for next stage payload
Attack Vector: Malicious packages uploaded to PyPI repository
Typosquatting and impersonation of popular Python packages
Indicators of Compromise: Packages named vConnector, VMConnect, ethter, quantiumbase, tablediter, request-plus, requestspro
C2 server communication via POST HTTP requests
Obfuscated Python modules using Base64 and XOR
builder.py file with payload decoding routine matching Lazarus group malware
Similarity to py_Qrcode and QRLog malware files
